name: fast-llm-compaction
description: Tool-call summarizing compaction for Claude Code sessions: every tool result over 200 chars becomes one LLM-written sentence of what it found and what follows from it.

provider.title: Summarizer provider
provider.description: `engine` uses the session's own model provider (no extra key); `http` uses an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint.

model.title: Summarizer model
model.description: Model for the one-sentence summaries. `haiku` for provider engine; a model id for provider http. LLM_MODEL overrides the default for http.

baseUrl.title: Summarizer base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL (provider http), e.g. https://llm.example.com/v1. Leave unset to use LLM_BASE_URL.

apiKey.title: Summarizer API key
apiKey.description: API key for the endpoint (provider http). Leave unset to use LLM_API_KEY.

minResultChars.title: Minimum result characters
minResultChars.description: Tool results at or below this many characters are kept verbatim; only longer ones are summarized.

maxToolInputChars.title: Maximum tool input characters
maxToolInputChars.description: Serialized tool inputs above this many characters are condensed to their informative skeleton.

maxPromptResultChars.title: Maximum result characters in the prompt
maxPromptResultChars.description: Characters of a tool result shown to the summarizer.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when summarization fails; 0 keeps only the note.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Below this estimated reduction the built-in summary runs instead.

preSummarize.title: Pre-summarize tool calls
preSummarize.description: Summarize tool results as they land (tool.call), so compaction reuses ready sentences.

preSummarizeAtPercent.title: Pre-summarize from percentage
preSummarizeAtPercent.description: Context percentage from which tool.call starts pre-summarizing; 0 always.

concurrency.title: Summarizer concurrency
concurrency.description: How many summarizer calls may be in flight at once.
